lead_raw_text:
The structure of Er4Al2Cu2 (reduced formula Er2AlCu) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Cu centers with 8 neighbors, and Er centers with either 14 or 16 neighbors, with Cu and Al polyhedra displaying corner- and edge-sharing and Al–Er polyhedra showing corner, edge, and face sharing. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all eight sites.
